app.about.blurb: Mod manager and loader for HELLDIVERS (2015).
app.about.forLuajit: Compiles mod scripts into code the game runs.
app.about.title: About Obsidian
app.action.deployHint: Write the active profile into the game
app.action.deployUpToDate: The game already has the active profile.
app.action.deployVanilla: Nothing is deployed; the game is vanilla.
app.action.deployWaiting: Changes are waiting. Writes the active profile into the game.
app.action.deployedVanilla: No mods are on, so the game is vanilla.
app.action.playHint: Deploys first when changes are waiting, then starts the game through Steam.
app.action.purgeHint: Remove everything Obsidian wrote into the game
app.action.purgedKept: Purged. %s files changed by another tool were left in place.
app.action.started: The game is starting through Steam.
app.crash.text: The game stopped while loading %s at the last launch.
app.drawer.conflictsMeta: Mods lower in the load order override the ones above them. Drag mods in the list to change which one wins.
app.drawer.hint: Select a mod to see its options, keys and files. Drop a mod folder or .zip anywhere in the window to add one.
app.drawer.keyHint: Click, then press the new key. Esc cancels.
app.drawer.noConflicts: No enabled mods change the same game files.
app.drawer.noFiles: This mod changes no game files.
app.drawer.removeText: Delete this mod from the library and from every profile. The game keeps it until the next Deploy or Purge.
app.error.BadImage: That file is not an image Obsidian can use: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
app.error.GameNotFound: The game was not found. Choose the game folder in Settings.
app.error.LastProfile: The last profile cannot be deleted.
app.error.ProfileExists: A profile with that name already exists.
app.error.ProfileName: Use 1 to 40 characters, without \ / : * ? " < > |, and without a space or dot at either end.
app.error.UnsupportedBuild: This game build is not one Obsidian knows, so it will not deploy to it.
app.home.subtitle: Mod Manager
app.image.chooseHint: A square image works best: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
app.mods.dropHint: Drop a mod folder or .zip anywhere in the window.
app.mods.orderHint: Drag rows to reorder. The lower mod wins a conflict.
app.mods.profileHint: The profile in use. Click to switch, create, rename or delete profiles.
app.nav.consent: Allow session mods from other players
app.nav.consentHint: Session mods from other Obsidian players stay off unless you turn this on. You then join a separate lobby pool with players who allow them too. Saved in the active profile.
app.profiles.consentOff: Session mods from other users not allowed
app.profiles.consentOn: Session mods from other Obsidian users allowed
app.profiles.deleteText: Delete this profile with its load order, options and keys. The mods stay in the library.
app.profiles.lead: A profile keeps the load order, which mods are on, option values, keys and the multiplayer setting. Switching profile asks for a Deploy when the mods in the game differ.
app.profiles.name: Name
app.profiles.title: Profiles
app.purge.text: Remove everything Obsidian wrote into the game, leaving it vanilla. Your library and profiles stay as they are.
app.purge.title: Purge
app.scope.clientHint: Changes only your game. Safe to play with anyone.
app.scope.sessionHint: Changes the game for the whole lobby, so it runs only when every player can run it too.
app.settings.animationsSystem: Off because Windows reduces motion. Switch them on here to override.
app.settings.backupsHint: Obsidian copies your saves before every deploy and keeps the latest ones.
app.settings.build.notFound: Choose the folder that holds the game's contents folder.
app.settings.build.unknown: This build is not one Obsidian knows, so deploys are blocked.
app.settings.dataHint: The library, profiles and save backups.
app.settings.noBackups: No backups yet. The first one is made at the first deploy.
app.settings.portable: Portable copy: the data folder sits beside the app.
app.settings.portableHint: Portable copy: download new versions from the releases page.
app.settings.updateMode: When a new version is out
app.settings.updates.autoHint: At startup, Obsidian installs a new version and restarts.
app.settings.updates.manualHint: Obsidian checks at startup and shows the new version here, nothing else.
app.settings.updates.promptHint: At startup, Obsidian asks before installing a new version.
app.settings.useSteamHint: Find the game through the Steam libraries again
app.status.notificationsHint: The notices shown so far, to read again
app.update.failed: Could not reach the releases page. Check your connection and try again.
app.update.installing: Installing. Obsidian opens again when it is done.
app.update.text: Install it now? Obsidian closes, installs the new version and opens again.
app.update.title: Obsidian %s is out
build_unknown: Obsidian: unknown game version, so no mods are running. Update Obsidian and deploy again.
campaign_not_uploaded: Progress was not uploaded to Galactic Campaign due to session mods
mod_failed: Obsidian: %s failed and is off until the game restarts.
session_not_cleared: Obsidian: other players here run different mods, and some of yours change game files that can't be paused. Consider leaving this game.
uploads_blocked: Obsidian: Galactic War and leaderboard results aren't sent while session mods are deployed.
